name: Metamorphose ~Fifth Entrance of For Season~
original_name: メタモルフォーゼ～Fifth Entrance of For Season～
source:
Main character is a thief who infiltrates a mansion. There he meets shrine maidens Yukino and Yuu sisters. The sisters are attacked by a demonic woman. Hero manages to protect the sisters with the help of a previously stolen item. However, such magic powers have a hidden secret...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名潜入宅邸的盗贼。在那里，他遇见巫女姐妹雪乃与优希。姐妹遭到一名魔性女子袭击，主人公借助先前偷来的物品设法保护她们。然而，那样的魔法力量背后隐藏着秘密……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
